decisionsTitle: «Clasament open (introdus manual)» and «Clasament elite (introdus manual)» instead of «(fără cip)» (amending §1031, §1032)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-22, answering a runner who asked how the ranking was made:** «În loc de „fără cip” scriem „introdus manual”». The two headings say how the ranking was made rather than what was missing: «Clasament open (introdus manual)» and «Clasament elite (introdus manual)»; in English «Open results (entered by hand)» and «Elite results (entered by hand)». Nothing else changes: the headings show under the same rule, and «Timpul a fost notat manual.» stays beside them.

**Tests.** `tests/integration/results/public-section.test.ts`.
changelogLine: - **Clasament: «(introdus manual)» în loc de «(fără cip)»** in the open and elite headings. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 80. Given a race whose results are on show while «Toate numele în clasament» is on, then the open ranking's heading reads «Clasament open (introdus manual)» and the elites' «Clasament elite (introdus manual)» — in English «Open results (entered by hand)» and «Elite results (entered by hand)» (2026-11-22, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/public-section.test.ts`.
